top_signals.title: Latin America Could Double Its Onshore Wind Capacity by 2035
top_signals.summary: Several countries across Latin America have been rapidly expanding their wind energy capacity to diversify the energy mix and strengthen energy security, with far more expansion planned for the next decade. Brazil and Mexico are leading the way, with several other countries across the region also beginning to develop their green energy sectors.  Across Latin America, installed wind energy capacity exceeded 44.7 GW in 2022.
